hints.title: Locating the First Mutated Digit
hints.text: To maximize the number, the first mutated digit must be as far left as possible and strictly increase its value.

hints.title: Extending the Contiguous Substring
hints.text: Continue mutating subsequent digits as long as their replacement digit is greater than or equal to the original digit.

hints.title: Terminating the Mutation Window
hints.text: Terminate the mutation immediately upon encountering the first digit where change[d] is strictly less than d.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all possible O(N^2) contiguous substrings is too slow for N = 100,000.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Most significant digits dominate place value, guaranteeing optimality of first greedy choice.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize stopping immediately after the first strictly smaller replacement.
